{{Quote| A man from the planet Dalicron-4 contacted us about a child that was strong in the Force.|Luke Skywalker, to the Rebels dispatched to find Caeleb on Dalicron-4|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
'''Caeleb''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] born during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who possessed an exceptional to connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Caeleb's coming was foretold roughly one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before his birth by a prophecy of a '''Child of Light''' and though he was unable to use the Force himself, through him other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals could access seemingly unlimited power in the Force. Caeleb's parents sought to shield him from his gift as he grew and raised him in a spot devoid of the Force on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when Caeleb was five years old, his quiet life was shattered by the coming of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]], who [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Caeleb's parents and attempted to apprehend the child. Caeleb was rescued by agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] resistance group but was soon after kidnapped by Skaros' master, the [[darksider]] [[Thaum Rystra]]. On the [[Water/Legends|ice]]-covered planet [[ZXK-100346.6a]], Caeleb assisted Rystra in the recovery of a [[Soulsaber|powerful dark side relic]]. However, Rystra was attacked by the Rebel agents that had saved Caeleb previously on Dalicron-4 and the boy was freed from Rystra's control. The Child of Light was subsequently transported by the Alliance to a safe location.

==Biography==
===The prophecy===
Caeleb was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and possessed an unparalleled connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that could be harnessed by other Force users to enhance their own powers. The subject of an ancient prophecy that heralded the coming of a "Child of Light," roughly one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before Caeleb's birth, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Duumas]] foretold the boy's coming. On the sparsely-populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Duumas [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] himself by merging consciousness into a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] to create bubble devoid of Force at which the child could reside. Caeleb was born<ref name="Child of Light" /> in around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]<ref name="Dates" /> to Force-sensitive parents and while in his [[Caeleb's mother|mother's]] [[Womb/Legends|womb]] she could sense that there was something special about her [[Youngling/Legends|baby]].<ref name="Child of Light" />

After [[Caeleb's father]] experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] revealing the location of Duumas' Force bubble, the boy's parents took their son to the spot to raise him, settling at a homestead next to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] tree. Caeleb's parents sought to keep him away from strong Force influences as he grew up, hoping to protect him from his power until he became more mature. Caeleb was brought up in a happy environment, his parents endeavoring to ensure that he experienced only positive emotions. His parents also forbade him from passing beyond a stone wall surrounding their homestead that marked the boundary of the Force bubble. The failed Jedi [[Gel (Jedi)|Gel]] who lived on a nearby [[Farm/Legends|farm]] learnt of Caeleb's existence and came to watch over the boy.<ref name="Child of Light" />

===Evading the dark side===
{{Quote|You&hellip;You have to save Caeleb. He must not fall to the darkness. You will find him in the place of no Force. You must hurry.|Gel, urging the Rebel agents to save Caeleb|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> when Caeleb was three years old, concerned that the Empire<ref name="Child of Light" /> and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="CSWE - Darth Vader">{{CSWECite|Vader, Darth|III|288}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] would find the boy and use Caeleb for their own ends, Gel sent word to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] resistance group of the existence the child strong in the Force. Gel requested that the Rebel Jedi [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] come to Dalicron-4 personally to escort Caeleb and the child's parents to safety. The Alliance leader [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] herself took an interest in Caeleb's plight. At around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]] [[Valik Kodank]] plotted to exploit Caeleb's Force potential to regain her physical form and she commanded her apprentice [[Thaum Rystra]] to capture the boy for her.<ref name="Child of Light" />

Rystra sent his protegee, the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]], to Dalicron-4 to apprehend Caeleb. The mission was Skaros' first proper assignment for Rystra and he was keen to be successful in acquiring the boy. After [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] Gel and forcing the elderly Jedi to divulge the Child of Light's location, Skaros commanded a force of [[Nek/Legends|nek battle dogs]] and [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] in a raid on Caeleb's homestead. The boy was [[Sleep/Legends|napping]] as Skaros began the assault and was awoken by his father's screams. Caeleb observed from a window as Skaros slew his father and the Dark Jedi's nek dogs brought down his mother, experiencing for the first time in his life feelings of unhappiness and dread. He hid under a bed, remaining silent to evade detection as a group of Rebel Alliance agents, who had been sent to Dalicron-4 in Luke Skywalker's stead to rescue the boy, defeated and killed Skaros.<ref name="Child of Light" />

The Rebels found Caeleb and the boy insisted that the Rebels bury his parents next to each other under Master Duumas' tree, believing that his mother and father would look after each other in death. Caeleb gathered up his belongings and plucked a leaf from tree and proffered it to one of the Rebels who was attuned the Force, leading to the Rebel experiencing a feeling of strength in the Force and a glimpse at Caeleb's power. The boy accompanied the Rebels to the nearby village [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]] and he was transported by them on the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]'',<ref name="Child of Light" /> accompanied by Gel's injured granddaughter [[Jhara]]<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref> to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari cruiser]] ''[[Home One/Legends|Home One]]'' Upon arrival the boy was placed in the custody of<ref name="Child of Light" /> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> [[Kylbar]], an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the Rebel leader [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], and Mon Mothma arranged for Caeleb to be escorted to a safe location.<ref name="Child of Light" />

===The Soulsaber===
{{Quote|Lieutenant Ryst&hellip;''"<br />"''No Kylbar. Commander Skywalker. You always did get us confused. I'll take Caeleb now. He will be safe with me.|Kylbar and Thaum Rystra, as Rystra apprehended Caeleb|<ref name="Soulsaber" />}}
Caeleb was taken in the company of Kylbar to a Rebel safe world. However, Rystra tracked him there and at a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] the [[darksider]] [[Mind trick/Legends|mindtricked]] Kylbar into handing Caeleb over to him. As the next step in Valik Kodank's scheme to regain her physical form, Rystra sought out the [[Soulsaber]], a powerful ancient [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side relic]], and he kept Caeleb close to him owing to the artifact being protected in a place that only an individual not touched by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] such as Caeleb could access. The Rebel agents that had saved Caeleb on Dalicron-4 were dispatched by the Alliance to recover the boy and searched for Rystra and Caeleb for [[Standard month/Legends|months]] as Rystra advanced his quest for the Soulsaber.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

In around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> four months after the death of Caeleb's parents, Rystra learned that a clue to the Soulsaber's location could be found on the<ref name="Soulsaber" /> [[Immerian Outback/Legends|Immerian Outback]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> planet [[Pamorjal]]. While en-route to Pamorjal, Rystra stopped over on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] with Caeleb to rendezvous with representatives of the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group. Rystra docked his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in a private bay in a busy [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and Caeleb gawked as they disembarked, having never seen a starport before. Caeleb accompanied Rystra to a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] where he meet with representatives of the PFL. Once Rystra's business was concluded, the Dark Jedi and Caeleb returned to the spaceport and departed Nar Shaddaa, bound for Pamorjal.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

Following their arrival on Pamorjal, Rystra made contact with the PFL leader [[Davit Berek]], instructing Berek to target the Rebel agents that were tailing him, and Caeleb was present during their conversation. From a complex of [[Temples of Vormijj|ancient Jedi temples]] on Pamorjal, Rystra identified that the Soulsaber could be found on the [[Water/Legends|ice]]-covered Outer Rim planet [[ZXK-100346.6a]] and he traveled there with Caeleb to recover the artifact.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

{{RPG|[[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']]}}
As they landed on the planet, Caeleb was apprehensive and cold, and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Force Adept|Force adept]] [[Sha'lia]], one of the Rebels tailing Rystra, [[Farsight/Legends|sensed remotely]] the emotions that the child was feeling. The Soulsaber was housed within the [[Cavern of Light]], a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] complex settled by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] earlier, surrounded by a barrier of [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side Force]] that Rystra could not cross. The Dark Jedi dispatched Caeleb to collect the relic for him as Rystra watched on and just as the Child of Light was about to hand over the Soulsaber, the Rebel agents arrived and attacked the darksider. Rystra [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitated]] Caeleb over a chasm and threatened to drop the boy unless the agents allowed the Dark Jedi to leave with the Soulsaber unmolested. The Rebels subsequently gained custody of Caeleb while Rystra fled the world with the Soulsaber.<ref name="Soulsaber" />
{{Endgame}}

Caeleb was taken by the Rebels back to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]]. Kylbar awaited their arrival with four [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of veteran [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and Caeleb was escorted away<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and transported by the Rebels to a secret secure location. Three years later,<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref> in around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> the Rebel agents ventured to a [[Temple of Pain|Sith temple]] in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]] on the hunt for Rystra and a phantom version of the Dark Jedi conjured by Valik Kodank asked them how Caeleb was.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|They'll take good care of each other.|Caeleb, to his Rebel rescuers, explaining his request that his parents be buried together|<ref name="Child of Light" />}}
At the time of Tol Skaros' attack, when Caeleb was five years old, the boy's emotions where easily influenced. He had an innocent upbringing and was frozen in terror when he witnessed the death of his parents, experiencing feelings of terror and sorrow for the first time in his life. He cared for his parents and ensured that they had a proper burial be he agreed to leave Dalicron-4 with his Rebel rescuers.<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Powers and abilities==
As the heralded Child of Light, Caeleb had a strong presence in the Force, which radiated from him. Though unable to use the Force himself, Caeleb had a direct<ref name="Child of Light" /> and unending<ref name="Soulsaber" /> connection to the Force. Other Force users could access seemingly unlimited [[Force energy]] and Force power through touching Caeleb, allowing feats that would usually be impossible to perform to be undertaken with ease.<ref name="Child of Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caeleb was created by [[Lee Pickler]] and featured in the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]] trilogy of [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventures published by [[RPGA]] and set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, within which he served as the eponymous "Child of Light." He first appeared in the opening instalment of the trilogy, ''[[Child of Light]]'', in [[2000]]<ref name="Child of Light" /> and featured again in the second adventure of the trilogy, [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']], in [[2001]].<ref name="Soulsaber" /> He was subsequently referenced in the third and final instalment in the trilogy, [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']], in [[2002]].<ref name="Light and Dark" />

===Inconsistencies===
An inconsistency exists between an outline of the ''Child of Light'' saga set out in ''Child of Light''<ref name="Child of Light" /> and the final adventure of the trilogy [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']] regarding Caeleb's role in the final act of the saga.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> In ''Child of Light'' it is stated that in the final part of the trilogy, Thaum Rystra takes Caeleb to Valik Kodank's Sith temple and attempts to resurrect Kodank by using the Soulsaber to convert Caeleb's Force energy into dark side energy.<ref name="Child of Light" /> However, Caeleb is absent from the final ''Child of Light'' adventure [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']] and Kodank instead seeks to regain her physical form by attempting to possess Sha'lia. This article assumes that ''Light and Dark'' portrays the correct sequence of events and that Caeleb was not taken to Kodank's temple.<ref name="Light and Dark" /> Another inconsistency exists regarding Caeleb's gender. Though ''Child of Light'', ''Soulsaber'' and ''Light and Dark'' consistently refer to Caeleb as male,<ref name="Child of Light" /><ref name="Soulsaber" /><ref name="Light and Dark" /> the roleplaying statistics provided for Caeleb in an appendix to ''Child of Light'' states Caeleb to be female.<ref name="Child of Light" /> This article assumes Caeleb to be male.

===Possible roleplay outcomes===
In ''Child of Light'', the players roleplay as the Rebel operatives that Caeleb encounters on Dalicron-4<ref name="Child of Light" /> and at the Cavern of Light. As the Rebels travel to the Cavern of Light to rescue Caeleb it is possible for the Force adept Sha'lia to use her farseeing ability to sense how Caeleb is feeling. The subsequent fight between Thaum Rystra and the Rebels in the Cavern of Light can play out in a number of ways; if the player characters arrive at the cavern before Caeleb has handed the Soulsaber to the Dark Jedi it is possible for the Rebels to attempt to encourage Caeleb not to hand over the relic to him. When Rystra attempts to escape, one possible ploy that he can use is to levitate Caeleb over a chasm and to threaten to let him fall unless the Rebels allow Rystra to leave. Whichever way the battle plays out, Rystra ultimately takes the Soulsaber from Caeleb and the Rebels gain custody of the boy.<ref name="Soulsaber" />
